title: UN Regulation No 155, vehicle cybersecurity
description: Preselected for automotive: keep it when the organization is a vehicle manufacturer, or a supplier whose system, component or software goes into a vehicle type that needs a cybersecurity approval under UN Regulation No 155, which Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 requires for the EU type-approval of categories M, N and O and which other contracting parties of the 1958 Agreement can apply. The approval and the certificate of the cyber security management system are the vehicle manufacturer's; a supplier is concerned through the manufacturer's management of its dependencies. Decline it for software that is not part of a vehicle, such as fleet management or workshop tools: ask the legal owner whether the Cyber Resilience Act applies to it instead (Art. 2(2)(c) leaves it out only for products covered by Regulation (EU) 2019/2144).
